## Excluding river routing
For model types `sbm` and `sbm_gwf` it is possible to run without river flow routing. The
following input parameters are required (e.g. to compute river fraction) and lateral inflow
to river (output variable) is available for coupling with an external routing model. River
evaporation and runoff (from precipitation) are not part of lateral inflow to river and
should be computed by the external routing model.

```toml
[model]
river_routing__flag = false
```

### Input
```{julia}
# | code-fold: true
include("../docs_utils.jl")
generate_table(Wflow.Routing, :no_river_flow_input; relative_widths = [6, 4, 2, 2, 2, 2])
```

### Output
```{julia}
# | code-fold: true
generate_table(Wflow.Routing, :no_river_flow_output; relative_widths = [3, 3, 1, 1, 2])
```
